criteria.frequency_detection: On a fault record, the labelled fault's tested line is significant (detected == true), whether or not the hypothesis is supported.
criteria.hit_criterion: A fault hits when its check's state is 'supported': a significant line of its own with at least one counted corroborating line, shared with no other hypothesis. The identical criterion is applied to the fault records and to the normal baselines. The check tests the rolling-element line at twice the ball spin frequency itself, so no fault has a harmonic leg.
criteria.indicated_precision: Indicated outcomes whose single candidate is the labelled fault, over every indicated outcome of the group.
criteria.named_fault: The fault type the check names: most_likely_fault, which it sets only when its claim level is 'single_spectrum_evidence'. Counted on the fault records as the labelled type, another type, or none.
criteria.normals: On the normal baselines, counts of each outcome kind, of named faults and of each supported fault type: counts on the recordings measured, never a rate.

outcome_classes.indicated_correct: Outcome 'indicated' with the labelled fault as its single candidate.
outcome_classes.indicated_wrong: Outcome 'indicated' with another fault as its single candidate; on a normal baseline, every indicated outcome.
outcome_classes.several_types_with_label: Outcome 'several_types' with the labelled fault among the candidates.
outcome_classes.several_types_without_label: Outcome 'several_types' without the labelled fault among the candidates; on a normal baseline, every several-types outcome.

criteria.ranking_rule: Secondary metric (classification, also reported as end_to_end). Among faults meeting the hit criterion: evidence tier (high before moderate), then fundamental peak magnitude descending, then absolute deviation_pct ascending, then the fixed BPFO/BPFI/BSF/FTF order. Classification is correct when the ranked-first fault maps to the label; it is computed on the fault records only. The check itself names no type on this ranking.
criteria.sensitivity: On a fault record, a bearing alert: outcome 'indicated' or 'several_types'.
criteria.strongest_candidate: On a fault record, the labelled fault is the first of the check's candidates. The check lists its candidates by level over the noise floor; that order does not rank which type is more likely.
criteria.wrong_type_support: On a fault record, a fault other than the labelled one meets the hit criterion.

metadata.dataset_subset: CWRU 12 kHz drive-end fault group + normal baselines (v1)
